title: Integral exceptional inverse image along a closed immersion
statement: Work in the standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], regarded as a condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. All derived categories use module objects over the pulled-back coefficient ring $\mathcal O_{E,T}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and $\Dbc$ means bounded constructible complexes [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $R\underline\Gamma_Z$ be the derived sections-with-support functor of [det-lem-formal-closed-support-derived]. For $K\in\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$, one has $R\underline\Gamma_ZK\in\Dbc(Z,\mathcal O_E)$ and an isomorphism $i^!K\simeq R\underline\Gamma_ZK$, natural in $K$, where $i^!$ is the integral right adjoint of [det-prop-int-brown-adjoint] on the full localizing categories $\Loc(\Dbc(-,\mathcal O_E))$ [sk-def-localizing-closure].

proof.text: The standing finite-type structure maps make X and Z locally Noetherian and quasi-compact, hence Noetherian. The range of the canonical open complement is exactly the complement of the closed range. The coefficient padicIntegersRingObj is admissible by the identity coefficient isomorphism.

Apply formal_closed_support_derived to the canonical open complement. It supplies additivity of the support functor, the closed direct-image/support adjunction and the distinguished triangle i_*RΓ_Z K → K → Rj_*j^*K. Apply condensed_open_closed_recollement to obtain exact closed direct image and the natural isomorphism i_* followed by i^* equals the identity.

Apply the fully proved integralComplementFiniteness to obtain triangulation of generators and constructibility of Rj_*j^*K. Isomorphism invariance and Mathlib ext_of_isTriangulatedClosed₁ applied to the support triangle give i_*RΓ_ZK in generators on X.

IntegralModelsOperations(1) preserves bounded constructibility under i^*. Apply the derived functor to the recollement isomorphism i_* followed by i^* equals the identity. Transport along its component using isomorphism invariance to obtain RΓ_ZK in generators on Z.

For every boundary compactification c, compare its integral compact-support functor with the proper compactification (id_Z,i), using integralLocalizingCompactSupport. Extension by zero along the identity is naturally the identity. Since i_* is exact, its right derived functor is naturally its termwise mapDerivedCategory. This produces the natural comparison from Ri_!^c to i_* on Loc.

Generators belong to their ordinary localizing closure by its intersection definition. For the specified adjunction Ri_!^c ⊣ G, invert the Brown Hom equivalence and compose with the comparison in step 5 and the ambient support adjunction. Fullness gives the resulting Hom equivalence within Loc. Yoneda constructs the comparison isomorphism GK ≅ RΓ_ZK, and naturality in K follows by transposing G.map g under both adjunctions. These are comparison, comparisonEquiv_left and comparisonEquiv_right in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Localization triangle, exact closed pull-push and explicit restricted Yoneda comparison, formalized by U3
